purpose: Specification-by-example scenarios for LIMS and ELN vendor evaluation

scenarios.title: Released result correction preserves the original
given: a released result with an attributable review event
when: a correction supplies a reason and successor revision
then: the original remains visible
the successor links to the original
downstream consumers receive the correction event
scenarios.failure_twin: a correction loses its reason, source revision, or original value
scenarios.recovery: restore the original relationship and replay the correction through the versioned write path

scenarios.title: Ambiguous vendor write reconciles before resubmission
given: a stable request identity and canonical content digest
when: the vendor commits and the client receives a timeout
then: readback locates one matching effect
the request resolves as converged
scenarios.failure_twin: changed content reuses the stable request identity
scenarios.recovery: preserve both content digests and resolve the collision through vendor readback

scenarios.title: Concurrent custody transfer reloads current position
given: a specimen at a versioned source location
when: a transfer proposes an earlier revision
then: the current position remains stable
the requester receives the current revision
scenarios.failure_twin: two transfers commit from the same expected revision
scenarios.recovery: reload current custody and construct a new attributable transfer

scenarios.title: Partial instrument artifact enters quarantine
given: an expected artifact identity and transfer manifest
when: received bytes produce a divergent content digest
then: the artifact enters quarantine
the received bytes and digest remain linked
the transfer can resume from a known boundary
scenarios.failure_twin: a replay carries the same identity and changed bytes
scenarios.recovery: request a complete transfer and reconcile against the preserved artifact metadata

scenarios.title: Sapio specimen graph matches independent readback
given: a configured tenant and supported SDK tuple
a synthetic specimen aliquot and plate graph
then: independent readback preserves identity and every relationship
plate semantics match the canonical graph
scenarios.failure_twin: records exist while a plate relationship remains semantically incomplete
scenarios.recovery: retain the fixture namespace, repair the mapping, and repeat the readback

scenarios.title: Benchling duplicate and late events converge
given: a verified webhook envelope and durable inbox
when: duplicate events arrive after a newer event
then: one refresh job remains active
authoritative API state drives reconciliation
scenarios.failure_twin: an event payload omits properties required for scientific meaning
scenarios.recovery: retrieve the current resource and use the event as a work signal

scenarios.title: LabKey validates and commits an atomic batch
given: a configured server with versioned modules and a restricted API identity
when: validate-only succeeds and the batch commits with an audit reason
then: normalized readback matches canonical content
audit and artifact digests reconcile
scenarios.failure_twin: one command in the batch carries an invalid value
scenarios.recovery: preserve zero committed effects and return the validation result

scenarios.title: Representative migration preserves meaning
given: a frozen source inventory and representative corpus
when: snapshot load and delta catch-up complete
then: identity, content, relationships, audit, signatures, and artifacts meet declared reconciliation thresholds
exceptions remain enumerable and reproducible
scenarios.failure_twin: an attachment digest or signature relationship diverges
scenarios.recovery: pause cutover, repair the mapping, and resume from the last durable checkpoint

scenarios.title: Clean-environment restore reconstructs the service
given: declared RTO and RPO
base backup, journals, artifacts, configuration references, and identity dependencies
when: an operator restores into a clean environment
then: records and evidence remain reconstructable
the service reaches its declared recovery objectives
scenarios.failure_twin: the newest backup or a journal segment is unavailable
scenarios.recovery: select the newest restore-proven recovery point and report the observed RPO

scenarios.title: Revoked identity loses tenant access within target
given: a tenant-scoped service identity and revocation objective
then: subsequent requests receive the expected authorization response
audit telemetry records the event and time
scenarios.failure_twin: a cached credential remains effective beyond the objective
scenarios.recovery: expire the affected cache and verify each authorization surface

scenarios.title: Rotated vendor credential advances through a bounded runtime cache
given: an environment-scoped workload role
configuration in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store
a vendor credential in AWS Secrets Manager
when: rotation advances the active secret version stage
then: the adapter resolves references with least privilege
the active version reaches runtime within the cache bound
telemetry records redacted version metadata
scenarios.failure_twin: protected material reaches a repository, build artifact, log, fixture, or telemetry event
scenarios.recovery: rotate the value, narrow the policy, and repeat retrieval and redaction checks

scenarios.title: Equivalent instants share one canonical representation
given: two timestamps describing one instant with different valid offsets
a microsecond precision and UTC policy
when: ingress validates and canonicalizes both values
then: both values produce the same canonical instant and semantic digest
each record retains source representation and recording time
scenarios.failure_twin: a source value carries an invalid offset or unsupported precision
scenarios.recovery: preserve the source representation and return a typed temporal exception

scenarios.title: Measured quantity preserves scientific precision and unit provenance
given: a versioned assay specification
a finite raw decimal value, unit, qualifier, and detection limit
when: the observation maps to its canonical UCUM quantity
then: raw and canonical values remain linked
precision, scale, conversion, assay revision, qualifier, and limits remain reconstructable
scenarios.failure_twin: the source unit lacks an assay-aware mapping
scenarios.recovery: preserve the raw observation and add the versioned mapping before scientific use

scenarios.title: Forced row security preserves tenant scope across access paths
given: two tenants with overlapping external specimen identities
an application role and owner-equivalent test role
forced default-deny row policies
when: each role exercises reads, writes, references, analytics, and backup posture
then: tenant-scoped operations observe and mutate their tenant rows
global evaluation data is deliberately de-identified
scenarios.failure_twin: a query or referential diagnostic reveals a cross-tenant row
scenarios.recovery: strengthen keys, policies, privileges, or diagnostics and replay the suite

scenarios.title: Correction history reconstructs from immutable events
given: a released result event and a later correction
when: the versioned write boundary records the correction and successor projection
then: the original event remains intact
the successor names causality and reason
projection replay reaches the same current state
scenarios.failure_twin: an application path updates or deletes the original event
scenarios.recovery: restore the append-only boundary and record the correction as a successor event

scenarios.title: Concurrent replay preserves one domain effect
given: a tenant, operation scope, stable request identity, and canonical request digest
two concurrent workers
when: one worker commits aggregate, event, and outbox intent while another retries identical and changed content
then: identical replay receives the original result
changed replay receives a typed conflict
Debezium publishes one stable event identity
scenarios.failure_twin: aggregate state and outbox visibility diverge
scenarios.recovery: reconcile aggregate, event, inbox, and outbox identities from the committed transaction

scenarios.title: Parallel migration branches converge through timestamped Flyway versions
given: timestamped versioned SQL
Flyway outOfOrder enabled
empty and populated predecessor fixtures
when: a later-merged lower timestamp and the current migration set apply in ephemeral PostgreSQL
then: Flyway validates checksums and names
every route reaches the same catalog
out-of-order state remains visible through Flyway info
scenarios.failure_twin: a duplicate timestamp or edited applied migration creates a conflict
scenarios.recovery: assign a fresh timestamp to unapplied work or add a forward corrective migration, then repeat the matrix

scenarios.title: Representative migration reconciles scientific and operational meaning
given: a stable source snapshot or watermark
a versioned transformation manifest
declared dimension thresholds
when: bounded batches load and delta convergence completes
then: identity, structure, semantics, relationships, distributions, artifacts, audit, and tenant security meet their criteria
exceptions remain enumerable and reproducible
scenarios.failure_twin: a dimension breaches its threshold or an exception loses source context
scenarios.recovery: retain the current write path, revise the mapping, and replay the affected dimensions
